eras.name: Hơi nước & cơ khí
eras.prompt: Create a professional hand-painted semi-realistic 2D SIDE-SCROLLING game background asset sheet for Quiz Duck Race. Reference image ONLY for grounded brushwork and camera geometry. Output EXACTLY FOUR DIFFERENT wide panoramic scenes in a precisely equal 2x2 grid, no frames, no text, no gutters, no labels; each quadrant is an independent landscape tile. The game ducks run from LEFT to RIGHT, not toward the horizon. Within EACH quadrant: sky and DISTANT horizon in top 50%; a totally clear straight horizontal running surface spanning full width between 52% and 76% of tile height; a cutaway of soil/material below 76%. Exactly same horizon and road Y in all four quadrants. No foreground buildings, no architecture assets standing on the road, no central roads receding into depth, no ducks, no characters, no obstacles, no smoke, no steam, no fog, no UI. Road top and bottom edges stay horizontal. Paint convincing material details on the road so camera scrolling reads clearly. All four scenes share consistent lighting, road material, and edge colors for sequential cross-blending, but show different surrounding vistas. Industry should be identifiable by SMALL DISTANT machinery/infrastructure silhouettes on the horizon, never huge buildings blocking the view. Do not mirror or repeat one image four times. Clean lush scenic art, natural materials, no fantasy glow, no crystals, no floating buildings. Era1 steam/mechanization, warm morning. Broad compacted ochre dirt running path with pebbles. Four vistas: cultivated valley with tiny distant waterwheel mill; distant railway embankment and low stone bridge; rolling farmland with a small steam-era works far away; wooded canal countryside with distant chimneys (NO drawn smoke). Rural early industrial materials.
